qualifying_updates.source_title: Agent of the Day - October 22, 2026: Architecture Guardian
qualifying_updates.source_type: official GitHub Agentic Workflows project blog
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The documented scheduled Architecture Guardian scans the preceding 24 hours of Go and JavaScript changes for structural thresholds and import cycles. It creates an expiring issue only when a finding exists, skips when a prior report remains open, restricts Bash to cat, and uses daily AI-credit and denial limits. Its audit log records both no-op runs and queued or successful outcomes.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Scheduled coding agents need bounded authority and observable quiet paths: precondition work on a narrow change window, limit their tools and budget, deduplicate durable outputs, expire stale findings, and distinguish an audited no-op from a failed or silent run.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: Do not create local product or framework coverage for GitHub, Copilot, or GitHub Agentic Workflows. If ingested, retain only the local scheduled-agent guardrail, auditability, and stale-finding lifecycle pattern.
